title: 实体文字世界穿行｜固定方向、材质接力与终点人像
source_title: 时装人物穿行巨型文字｜空间单词接力后回到完整身份
summary: 同一成年时装人物沿固定方向穿过由巨型实体短词构成的空间；每个词用不同材质承担一段地理和动作职责，镜头持续证明人物与字块的前后关系，最后以完整人像和原创主标收束。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject and a fixed dark spatial axis before material typography appears. + Assign each module one short original word, one material family and one physical behavior. + Keep the subject identity and travel direction continuous while material physics change. + Compress prior modules through a bounded aperture, ribbon or paper relay rather than random cuts. + Converge all material channels into one stable terminal portrait and readable original title.
recommended_input: 建立一名原创明确成年城市规划师：铜色辫发、炭灰外套、青绿色围巾与方形银框眼镜；她站在狭长混凝土文字廊入口。；空间方向不反转，依次穿过半透明琥珀材质【FORM】与粗糙蓝石材质【BUILD】；每次转场只由一条前景字边遮挡触发。；在文字廊出口以干净近景人像和准确短标【CITY IN WORDS】结束并停留到可读；不复制任何来源名称、造型或字幕。
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and one forward spatial route are established before the first word crossing.
Every word is a physical volume with readable foreground, interior and background relationships.
At least one visible body-to-letter contact proves the typography belongs to the same world.
The final portrait occurs beyond the last word and carries one exact original master title.
